report:
Testis, left, orchidectomy

Received in formalin is a left testis, measuring 4 x 3 x 2.5 cm. Representative sections in 3 blocks.

(1-3) Testis, representative sections.

Sections show testis with complete haemorrhagic infarction; the germ cells in all the seminiferous tubules are necrotic. The features are those of testicular torsion, Mikuz grade 3. There is no evidence of malignancy.

TESTIS, left, orchidectomy - In keeping with TORSION OF TESTIS, Mikuz grade 3
